_about: cc-P773: the Play Test Goblin's task cards (scripts/playtest_goblin.py). Each card is one thing a play tester can do and report on, in plain player language, with the play-test item it gives evidence for (testId: a T- row or a prompt's item on the play-test page). The Goblin hands them out in this order within the same rank, so the Wakening Isle path comes first. A card is never given twice to the same tester. Add cards at the end; never reuse a key; set retired true to stop handing one out. Coordinates are on the Wakening Isle (each new character wakes on a private copy of it) unless the card says otherwise. Testers only report what they saw: Chase marks Pass or Fail. cc-P789: needsPlayer true means the card needs a normal player account (a new character, character creation, Young status, the tutorial, anything staff powers skip or change); the Goblin never gives such a card to a staff account. A card without the field is treated as needing one. Every Wakening Isle card needs one: each starts from a new character on its own private copy of the isle, which a staff account does not get.

cards.title: Make a brand new character
cards.why: Every new player starts here. If creation goes wrong, nobody reaches the game.
cards.where: The character creation screen, then the Wakening Isle beach
steps: Log in and make a new character on the test shard. Pick any look, skills and starting city you like.
Try asking for a different race (for example an Elf) if the screen lets you.
Finish and enter the world.
cards.lookFor: You wake on a sandy beach as a Human. If you asked for another race, a line tells you why you are Human. Note anything confusing on the creation screen.

cards.title: Wake up on the beach and get up
cards.why: The very first minute of play. The hint has to tell you how to move.
cards.where: The Wakening Isle beach, where you wake
steps: Read the lines that appear while you lie on the sand.
Get up the way the hint says (an arrow key, or holding the right mouse button on the ground).
cards.lookFor: You can see your character lying on the sand, the hint says how to get up, and doing that stands you up. Say if anything took you more than a minute to work out.

cards.title: Meet Tamsin and open your lessons
cards.why: Tamsin is the guide for the whole island. A lost lesson window must be easy to get back.
cards.where: Tamsin, standing on the beach just east of where you wake
steps: Follow the arrow to Tamsin and double-click her.
Close the lesson window with its X.
Type [lesson and press Enter. Then close it again and just say lesson (no bracket).
cards.lookFor: Both ways bring the lesson window back. The window says what to do in words you understand.

cards.title: The walk and run lesson
cards.why: Moving is the first real lesson. The glowing tiles have to be easy to find.
cards.where: The road up from the beach: a blue floor tile, then a gold one
steps: Start the Walk and run lesson.
Walk onto the blue tile, then onto the gold tile.
Try running by pointing farther from your character while holding the right mouse button.
cards.lookFor: The tiles are easy to see, stepping on them finishes the lesson, and the window then says what is next.

cards.title: The backpack lesson
cards.why: Opening your character window and backpack is something every player does all the time.
steps: Start the Your backpack lesson and follow the arrow to the camp.
Click your character once and choose Open Paperdoll (or double-click yourself).
Double-click the backpack picture, then double-click the blue practice bag inside.
cards.lookFor: Each step in the lesson window matches what the game actually shows you, in the same order.

cards.title: Put on the blue cloak
cards.why: This teaches drag and drop, which players need for almost everything.
cards.where: The table by the clothes rack
steps: Start the cloak lesson and follow the arrow to the table.
Open the chest that appears and drag the blue cloak onto your character's picture.
cards.lookFor: A chest appears, the cloak is inside, and wearing it finishes the lesson. The chest goes away afterwards.

cards.title: The chat lesson
cards.why: Talking is how players use banks, shops and other players.
steps: Start the chat lesson and follow the arrow to the signpost.
Press Enter, type I am ready to learn, and press Enter again.
cards.lookFor: Saying the phrase finishes the lesson. You can find what you said in your Journal.

cards.title: Clear the pests on Wren's farm and get your pet
cards.why: Your first fight and your first pet both happen here.
cards.where: Wren the Farmhand at the farm gate, then the cabbage rows
steps: Start the farm lesson and double-click Wren (she wears a straw hat).
Hold the pitchfork she gives you, press Tab for war mode, and clear the pests in the cabbage rows.
Go back to Wren, take your pet, and try the commands she teaches (all follow me, all guard me).
cards.lookFor: The pests can be found and fought, the gate opens and closes sensibly, and your pet follows your commands.

cards.title: Bandage Pip in the farmhouse
cards.why: Healing is how new players stay alive. It has to be clear that a bandage takes a few seconds.
cards.where: Pip, the hurt farm boy, on the bench inside the farmhouse
steps: Start the healing lesson and go into the farmhouse.
Double-click a bandage in your backpack, then click Pip.
Stand still until you see that you finished applying the bandages.
cards.lookFor: You get bandages, Pip can be healed, and the lesson finishes. Say if you were ever unsure whether it was working.

cards.title: The death lesson
cards.why: Dying for the first time should not be scary or confusing, and it must never disconnect you.
cards.where: The training yard: the pale gray rat and Sera beside it
steps: Start the death lesson and double-click the pale gray rat, then click Ready.
After you die, double-click Sera and click Resurrect.
cards.lookFor: You come back to life with your things. Tell us right away if the game disconnects you at any point here.

cards.title: The bank lesson
cards.why: The bank keeps players' things safe. An earlier tester found the blue token missing on the first try.
cards.where: The practice bank in the trades square: Merrin the banker
steps: Go into the practice bank and say bank to Merrin.
Drag the blue practice token from your backpack into the bank box.
cards.lookFor: The token is in your backpack the first time, the bank box opens, and depositing the token finishes the lesson.

cards.title: Visit Elara in the League lodge
cards.why: The League is how players find their way after the island.
cards.where: The League lodge: enter by the door on its north side, Elara Voss inside
steps: Start the League lesson and follow the arrow to the lodge.
Double-click Elara Voss (or click her once and choose Talk).
Read her window. Join or close it, as you like.
cards.lookFor: Her window opens and the lesson finishes. The window makes sense even if you do not join.

cards.title: Watch the vision at the standing stones
cards.why: The vision is the story's first scene. It holds you still for about a minute.
cards.where: The standing stones on the knoll
steps: Start the vision lesson and double-click its signpost at the stones.
Watch until the vision ends.
cards.lookFor: The vision plays through (it may take you to another place for the scene) and brings you back afterwards. Say if anything looked broken or went on too long.

cards.title: Take the dock moongate to New Haven
cards.why: This is the end of the island. Your pet must come with you.
cards.where: The blue moongate at the end of the dock
steps: When your lessons are done, walk into the moongate at the end of the dock.
Look around where you arrive.
cards.lookFor: You and your pet arrive next to Rook on the New Haven plaza, and someone tells you what to do next.

cards.title: Skip the island on a second character
cards.why: Players who already know the game will run straight for the gate. That has to work and be a little funny.
cards.where: A second new character on the same account, from the beach to the dock moongate
steps: Make another new character on the same account.
Ignore the lessons and run straight to the moongate at the end of the dock.
Walk through it.
cards.lookFor: You cross to New Haven, get a line about not reading the sign, and a box with a pet choice scroll.

cards.title: Walk the island's coast and the wreck
cards.why: Odd tiles, holes or invisible walls are easiest to spot by just walking around.
cards.where: All around the Wakening Isle's shore, including the shipwreck
cards.coords: the island runs from about 6594, 3905 to 6865, 4049
steps: Walk slowly along the whole shoreline.
Look at the shipwreck up close.
cards.lookFor: Anywhere you can walk where you should not (or cannot where you should), black gaps, floating or cut-off pieces.

cards.retiredWhy: Not on the test shard yet: P764 is on main, not on the isle release the testers play. Set retired to false once the test shard runs main.
cards.title: Leash and shrink your starter pet
cards.why: New players need an easy way to carry their first pet around town.
cards.where: New Haven, with the pet you got on the island
steps: Find the leash or shrink option for your starter pet (look in your backpack and the pet's menu).
Shrink the pet, carry it a short way, and bring it back out.
cards.lookFor: It is easy to find out how, the pet shrinks and comes back, and it still follows your commands.
